key.name: method
key.description: 选择开合角度检测方案：camera（摄像头，默认）或 sonar（超声波）。 (Choose the lid-angle detection method: camera (default) or sonar (ultrasonic).)

key.name: blur-strength
key.description: 折叠时屏幕顶部的模糊强度（0=无模糊，越大越模糊，底部始终清晰）。 (Blur strength at the top of the screen when folded; 0 means no blur, higher means blurrier, the bottom stays clear.)
